data.title: bn-36luu: evidence-class membership changes route to review (RFC 0031 corr. 20)

data.body: [severity:info][risk:high] Failure modes: a missed assurance added/removed record, wrong verb exemption, or wrong acceptance path could restore a fail-open allow. This branch intercepts the two membership relations after P3 and before P4. Edge cases: added and removed classes, both acceptance paths, all five admissible assurance verbs, mixed records, and set-order permutations are covered at evidence_class_membership_review.rs:201-470. Rollback: reverting this range restores the known no-downgrade fail-open case. Disable affected acceptance or require locked/review until a correction lands. Monitoring: alert on any assurance added/removed reason that yields allow under no-downgrade. Validation: traced IntentContract decoding through artifact classification and PolicyTable::verdict, reviewed both commits and all nine changed files, checked the C020 golden deltas, and ran git diff --check. I did not run builds because reviewer writes are limited to Seal metadata. The risk:critical human-approval gate remains separate from this static vote.

data.reason: Informational risk assessment; no code action requested.
